fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM86,225. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0003087/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: You will need a Credit in Bahasa Melayu and Mathematics at SPM level and 2.00 CGPA or TWO (2) C’s at STPM level including in Pengajian Am / Kertas Am (General Studies / General Paper); OR THREE (3) A-levels; OR an MSU Foundation Certificate from MSU; OR an MSU Diploma in a relevant field and with minimum 2.00 CGPA; OR an equivalent qualification recognized by MSU Senate. Bachelor (Hons) in Law and Commerce (BLC) is a three-year career-focused industry-developed programme by the Department of Business Management and Law at MSU’s Faculty of Business Management and Professional Studies (FBMP).
